You translate a traveller's one-day trip request in Singapore into a Python program that uses the z3
solver (`import z3`) to find a schedule satisfying EVERY requirement, or prove that none exists.

Facts (times in minutes since midnight, e.g. 09:00 = 540; money in whole SGD):
Places (id | name | cost | typical duration | open-close | showtimes):
botanic_gardens | Singapore Botanic Gardens | 0 | 120 | 05:00-24:00 | -
bird_paradise | Bird Paradise | 49 | 180 | 09:00-18:00 | -
supertree_grove | Supertree Grove | 0 | 45 | 05:00-24:00 | -
adventure_cove | Adventure Cove Waterpark | 40 | 180 | 10:00-17:00 | -
national_gallery | National Gallery Singapore | 25 | 150 | 10:00-19:00 | -
orchid_garden | National Orchid Garden | 15 | 60 | 08:30-19:00 | -
clarke_quay | Clarke Quay | 30 | 90 | 17:00-24:00 | -
artscience | ArtScience Museum | 30 | 90 | 10:00-19:00 | -
east_coast_lagoon | East Coast Lagoon Food Village | 15 | 60 | 10:30-22:30 | -
wings_of_time | Wings of Time | 19 | 20 | 19:30-21:30 | 19:40, 20:40
chinatown_complex | Chinatown Complex Food Centre | 8 | 45 | 07:00-22:00 | -
Travel times in minutes between places (row -> column):
botanic_gardens: bird_paradise 36, supertree_grove 26, adventure_cove 25, national_gallery 22, orchid_garden 11, clarke_quay 21, artscience 24, east_coast_lagoon 42, wings_of_time 27, chinatown_complex 22

supertree_grove: botanic_gardens 26, bird_paradise 49, adventure_cove 24, national_gallery 14, orchid_garden 26, clarke_quay 16, artscience 12, east_coast_lagoon 30, wings_of_time 25, chinatown_complex 16
adventure_cove: botanic_gardens 25, bird_paradise 51, supertree_grove 24, national_gallery 23, orchid_garden 25, clarke_quay 22, artscience 24, east_coast_lagoon 44, wings_of_time 13, chinatown_complex 20
national_gallery: botanic_gardens 22, bird_paradise 46, supertree_grove 14, adventure_cove 23, orchid_garden 22, clarke_quay 12, artscience 13, east_coast_lagoon 33, wings_of_time 24, chinatown_complex 14
orchid_garden: botanic_gardens 11, bird_paradise 37, supertree_grove 26, adventure_cove 25, national_gallery 22, clarke_quay 21, artscience 24, east_coast_lagoon 42, wings_of_time 27, chinatown_complex 21
clarke_quay: botanic_gardens 21, bird_paradise 45, supertree_grove 16, adventure_cove 22, national_gallery 12, orchid_garden 21, artscience 14, east_coast_lagoon 34, wings_of_time 24, chinatown_complex 13
artscience: botanic_gardens 24, bird_paradise 48, supertree_grove 12, adventure_cove 24, national_gallery 13, orchid_garden 24, clarke_quay 14, east_coast_lagoon 31, wings_of_time 25, chinatown_complex 15
east_coast_lagoon: botanic_gardens 42, bird_paradise 58, supertree_grove 30, adventure_cove 44, national_gallery 33, orchid_garden 42, clarke_quay 34, artscience 31, wings_of_time 45, chinatown_complex 36
wings_of_time: botanic_gardens 27, bird_paradise 52, supertree_grove 25, adventure_cove 13, national_gallery 24, orchid_garden 27, clarke_quay 24, artscience 25, east_coast_lagoon 45, chinatown_complex 21
chinatown_complex: botanic_gardens 22, bird_paradise 47, supertree_grove 16, adventure_cove 20, national_gallery 14, orchid_garden 21, clarke_quay 13, artscience 15, east_coast_lagoon 36, wings_of_time 21

Rules of the domain: a visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical one unless the traveller gives one); it must
lie within opening hours; a show may only start at one of its showtimes; visits cannot overlap and consecutive
visits need the travel time between them; must-visit places are required, optional ones may be skipped;
budget is the sum of costs of visited places.

Contract: output ONE python code block. When run, the program must print exactly one final line:
either the word UNSAT, or a JSON list of objects {"location_id": id, "start": minutes, "end": minutes}
for the visited places. Do not read input, do not use the network, do not print anything after that line.

Example of the output format only: [{"location_id": "museum", "start": 540, "end": 660}]

Hey, I’ve got some free time from 16:00 to 23:55 and a budget of S$45. Really hoping to hit up Singapore Botanic Gardens, Wings of Time, and Chinatown Complex Food Centre. 

If there’s still time, I’d love to check out Bird Paradise, Supertree Grove, Adventure Cove Waterpark, National Gallery Singapore, National Orchid Garden, Clarke Quay, ArtScience Museum, and East Coast Lagoon Food Village. Just a heads up, I need to do the ArtScience Museum before East Coast Lagoon Food Village.

For the timings, here’s what I’m looking at: 210 minutes at Bird Paradise, 180 minutes at National Gallery Singapore, 30 minutes at National Orchid Garden, 90 minutes at East Coast Lagoon Food Village, and 70 minutes at Chinatown Complex Food Centre. Also, I need to be at Chinatown Complex Food Centre no earlier than 19:35 and finished there by 20:45.

response:
```python
import json
from z3 import *

# Create solver
s = Solver()

# Time window: 16:00 (960) to 23:55 (1435)
DAY_START = 960
DAY_END = 1435
BUDGET = 45

# Locations data
locations = {
    "botanic_gardens": {"cost": 0, "duration": 120, "open": 300, "close": 1440, "showtimes": []},
    "bird_paradise": {"cost": 49, "duration": 210, "open": 540, "close": 1080, "showtimes": []},
    "supertree_grove": {"cost": 0, "duration": 45, "open": 300, "close": 1440, "showtimes": []},
    "adventure_cove": {"cost": 40, "duration": 180, "open": 600, "close": 1020, "showtimes": []},
    "national_gallery": {"cost": 25, "duration": 180, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "showtimes": []},
    "orchid_garden": {"cost": 15, "duration": 30, "open": 510, "close": 1140, "showtimes": []},
    "clarke_quay": {"cost": 30, "duration": 90, "open": 1020, "close": 1440, "showtimes": []},
    "artscience": {"cost": 30, "duration": 90, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "showtimes": []},
    "east_coast_lagoon": {"cost": 15, "duration": 90, "open": 630, "close": 1350, "showtimes": []},
    "wings_of_time": {"cost": 19, "duration": 20, "open": 1170, "close": 1290, "showtimes": [1180, 1240]},
    "chinatown_complex": {"cost": 8, "duration": 70, "open": 420, "close": 1320, "showtimes": []},
}

travel_times = {
    "botanic_gardens": {"bird_paradise": 36, "supertree_grove": 26, "adventure_cove": 25, "national_gallery": 22, "orchid_garden": 11, "clarke_quay": 21, "artscience": 24, "east_coast_lagoon": 42, "wings_of_time": 27, "chinatown_complex": 22},
    "bird_paradise": {"botanic_gardens": 36, "supertree_grove": 49, "adventure_cove": 51, "national_gallery": 46, "orchid_garden": 37, "clarke_quay": 45, "artscience": 48, "east_coast_lagoon": 58, "wings_of_time": 52, "chinatown_complex": 47},
    "supertree_grove": {"botanic_gardens": 26, "bird_paradise": 49, "adventure_cove": 24, "national_gallery": 14, "orchid_garden": 26, "clarke_quay": 16, "artscience": 12, "east_coast_lagoon": 30, "wings_of_time": 25, "chinatown_complex": 16},
    "adventure_cove": {"botanic_gardens": 25, "bird_paradise": 51, "supertree_grove": 24, "national_gallery": 23, "orchid_garden": 25, "clarke_quay": 22, "artscience": 24, "east_coast_lagoon": 44, "wings_of_time": 13, "chinatown_complex": 20},
    "national_gallery": {"botanic_gardens": 22, "bird_paradise": 46, "supertree_grove": 14, "adventure_cove": 23, "orchid_garden": 22, "clarke_quay": 12, "artscience": 13, "east_coast_lagoon": 33, "wings_of_time": 24, "chinatown_complex": 14},
    "orchid_garden": {"botanic_gardens": 11, "bird_paradise": 37, "supertree_grove": 26, "adventure_cove": 25, "national_gallery": 22, "clarke_quay": 21, "artscience": 24, "east_coast_lagoon": 42, "wings_of_time": 27, "chinatown_complex": 21},
    "clarke_quay": {"botanic_gardens": 21, "bird_paradise": 45, "supertree_grove": 16, "adventure_cove": 22, "national_gallery": 12, "orchid_garden": 21, "artscience": 14, "east_coast_lagoon": 34, "wings_of_time": 24, "chinatown_complex": 13},
    "artscience": {"botanic_gardens": 24, "bird_paradise": 48, "supertree_grove": 12, "adventure_cove": 24, "national_gallery": 13, "orchid_garden": 24, "clarke_quay": 14, "east_coast_lagoon": 31, "wings_of_time": 25, "chinatown_complex": 15},
    "east_coast_lagoon": {"botanic_gardens": 42, "bird_paradise": 58, "supertree_grove": 30, "adventure_cove": 44, "national_gallery": 33, "orchid_garden": 42, "clarke_quay": 34, "artscience": 31, "wings_of_time": 45, "chinatown_complex": 36},
    "wings_of_time": {"botanic_gardens": 27, "bird_paradise": 52, "supertree_grove": 25, "adventure_cove": 13, "national_gallery": 24, "orchid_garden": 27, "clarke_quay": 24, "artscience": 25, "east_coast_lagoon": 45, "chinatown_complex": 21},
    "chinatown_complex": {"botanic_gardens": 22, "bird_paradise": 47, "supertree_grove": 16, "adventure_cove": 20, "national_gallery": 14, "orchid_garden": 21, "clarke_quay": 13, "artscience": 15, "east_coast_lagoon": 36, "wings_of_time": 21}
}

# Decision variables
visited = {loc: Bool(f"visited_{loc}") for loc in locations}
start = {loc: Int(f"start_{loc}") for loc in locations}
end = {loc: Int(f"end_{loc}") for loc in locations}

# Must-visit places
must_visit = ["botanic_gardens", "wings_of_time", "chinatown_complex"]
for loc in must_visit:
    s.add(visited[loc] == True)

# Budget constraint
total_cost = Sum([If(visited[loc], locations[loc]["cost"], 0) for loc in locations])
s.add(total_cost <= BUDGET)

for loc in locations:
    dur = locations[loc]["duration"]
    op = locations[loc]["open"]
    cl = locations[loc]["close"]
    showtimes = locations[loc]["showtimes"]

    # Duration and bounds
    s.add(end[loc] == start[loc] + dur)
    s.add(start[loc] >= DAY_START)
    s.add(end[loc] <= DAY_END)

    # Opening hours
    s.add(start[loc] >= op)
    s.add(end[loc] <= cl)

    # If not visited, maybe bounds are trivial, but let's enforce valid time range
    s.implies(visited[loc], And(start[loc] >= op, end[loc] <= cl))

    # Showtimes if applicable
    if showtimes:
        show_conds = [start[loc] == st for st in showtimes]
        s.implies(visited[loc], Or(show_conds))

# Specific constraints
# Chinatown Complex: no earlier than 19:35 (1175) and finished by 20:45 (1245)
s.implies(visited["chinatown_complex"], start["chinatown_complex"] >= 1175)
s.implies(visited["chinatown_complex"], end["chinatown_complex"] <= 1245)

# ArtScience Museum before East Coast Lagoon Food Village
s.implies(And(visited["artscience"], visited["east_coast_lagoon"]), 
          end["artscience"] + travel_times["artscience"]["east_coast_lagoon"] <= start["east_coast_lagoon"])

# No overlapping visits and travel time between consecutive visits
loc_list = list(locations.keys())
for i in range(len(loc_list)):
    for j in range(len(loc_list)):
        if i != j:
            loc1 = loc_list[i]
            loc2 = loc_list[j]
            t_time = travel_times[loc1][loc2]
            # If both visited, either loc1 ends + travel <= loc2 start, OR loc2 ends + travel <= loc1 start
            s.add(Or(
                Not(visited[loc1]),
                Not(visited[loc2]),
                start[loc2] >= end[loc1] + t_time,
                start[loc1] >= end[loc2] + t_time
            ))

# Solve
if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    result = []
    for loc in locations:
        if is_true(m[visited[loc]]):
            result.append({
                "location_id": loc,
                "start": m[start[loc]].as_long(),
                "end": m[end[loc]].as_long()
            })
    # Sort by start time just to be neat
    result.sort(key=lambda x: x["start"])
    print(json.dumps(result))
else:
    print("UNSAT")
```
